decisions.why: Minimus II, Ri Champion N, R1 Shock Proof, E Mega are all blood pressure monitors for patient vital signs monitoring
Elitevue Macro Otoscope and E Scope Otoscope are video endoscopes for ENT; Schiotz Tonometer and Ophthalmoscope are ophthalmology diagnostic equipment
Ri Thermo N Professional, Ri Thermo Sensiopro, Ri Gital Digital, Ri Thermo N Clinical are all digital thermometers for patient temperature monitoring
Ri Sat Pedi, Rvs 100 Vital Signs Monitor, Ri Sat Bt, Ri Fox N Pulse Oximeter are vital signs monitoring equipment
Ri Sat Pulse Oximeter is a pulse oximetry device for patient monitoring
Ri Standard Direct Illuminated, Ri Integral Fibre Optic, Ri Dispo, Ri Modul Fibre Optic laryngoscopes are intubating endoscopes used in ENT and airway management
Ri Scope Operation Otoscope Veterinary, Vet I Oto Ophthalmoscope, and Vet I Otoscope are veterinary diagnostic equipment
